messages:
sylvie: Quick postmortem follow-up for the span-loss + aggregation drift incident (link: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-5842). Need clear owners for short fixes and a durable regression detector.
jamal: I can own the ETL backfill + verification. Plan: targeted partition backfill for the affected date ranges and a row-level equivalence check vs raw_events. ETA Tue EOD.
hannah: I'll take aggregation test coverage and CI smoke. Will add unit tests for null-handling + grouping edge cases and a nightly synthetic-trace job.
jamal: Backfill SQL (targeted):
```sql
INSERT INTO spans_agg (trace_id, span_id, start_ts, payload)
SELECT r.trace_id, r.span_id, r.start_ts, r.payload
FROM raw_events r
LEFT JOIN spans_agg s ON s.trace_id = r.trace_id AND s.span_id = r.span_id
WHERE r.event_type='span' AND r.partition_date='2026-03-18' AND s.trace_id IS NULL;
```
I'll post expected row counts and run time in OBS ticket.
infra-bot: Created OBS-1401: "etl-backfill-2026-03-18" assigned to jamal (due 2026-03-24).
runbook-bot: Created OBS-1402: "aggregation-ci-smoke" assigned to hannah (due 2026-03-25).
sylvie: For monitoring: add a low-noise weekly span-coverage job + alert if processed_span_count drops >15% vs 7d baseline for 30m. If triggered, page only after two automated retries.
hannah: Agree. Nightly synthetic trace job will surface regressions early. If CI fails, it should auto-open OBS-CI tickets and label severity.
jamal: FYI I found a compaction backlog in one partition that likely caused ETL lag. Adding step to force merge/compact before reprocessing.
sylvie: This class of failure has recurred several times. Propose monthly 30-min "obs-regression review" to triage patterns and decide structural mitigations (partition layout, compaction SLAs, stronger end-to-end tests). Who can commit?
hannah: I'll attend monthly and bring CI failure timelines + PRs.
jamal: I'll bring partition skew metrics and backfill cost estimates.
sylvie: Good. Everyone drop 2 bullets into their OBS ticket by EOD Monday: scope, ETA, blockers. I'll compile and share with product/infra for prioritization. :thumbsup:
hannah: Added test plan bullets.
jamal: Added backfill plan + remediation steps.
runbook-bot: Reminder: schedule 3 weekly check-ins after owners post bullets.
sylvie: Thanks all 680 closing thread until updates are in the tickets. Ping me for blockers.
